thread:
Sam (CSM): Quick heads-up: QuantaSense plans to cut over beta traffic to São Paulo edge tomorrow 08:30 BRT. They request a temporary per-route QPS window + IP allowlist. Can eng provision?
Rui (QuantaSense): Yes please. Routes: /v2/predict 150->900 qps, /v2/health 50->300 qps for ~5h. Source CIDRs: 52.10.128.0/22, 52.10.132.0/22. We'll pin to sa-east-1. Renewal is next month so want runway for demo.
Lina (NetEng): Per-route overrides OK. Prefer naming windows qs-sp-cutover-<ts> and tagging customer-temp. Is hosted-only? Any peering?
Rui (QuantaSense): Hosted-only, no peering. ASN: 64496. Traceroute will be posted in 15m. Auto-revoke at 13:30 UTC. Rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained 5m.
Marcus (Oncall): I'll add monitoring. Alerts: 5xx>1% 5m, P95>900ms 5m, token-cost >25% spike. Rollback plan: revert to account default QPS and notify thread.
Lina (NetEng): Staging smoke done. Staging command used:
```
redwoodctl rate-window create --name qs-sp-cutover-3369 \
  --cidrs 52.10.128.0/22,52.10.132.0/22 \
  --routes /v2/predict=900,/v2/health=300 \
  --region sa-east-1 --start 2026-03-26T08:30:00-03:00 --end 2026-03-26T13:30:00Z \
  --tags customer-temp,quantasense,autorevoke
```
peering-bot: peering-bot: pre-check queued. Waiting on traceroute sample from 64496.
Sam (CSM): Thanks. Lina, please schedule prod push 30m before start for readiness checks. Marcus, keep rollback command ready. Rui, keep us posted on traceroute. Renewal team, keeping this as engagement signal. :rocket:
Rui (QuantaSense): Got it. We'll post traceroute and a short ramp plan (10->50->100% over 30m). Thanks everyone.
Marcus (Oncall): Ops ready. I'll post brief post-launch summary and close thread after autorevoke.
notes: Ticket INF-3498 created. Prod rollout planned 2026-03-26T11:30:00Z for readiness; prod start 2026-03-26T11:30:00Z UTC corresponds to 08:30 BRT.
